description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommand' implementing the 'Command' interface, which provides a common base for different command types within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles command creation, JSON serialization, header validation, and equality checks. The class is generic and designed for extension by specific command implementations.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for commands in the Ditto framework, providing common functionality such as headers management, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the command's manifest representation, defaulting to its type.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this command.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command into a JSON object, based on the specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to append command-specific JSON payload content.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on headers and type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this command and another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checks, ensuring type compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
